series_break: ESI-2 -> ESI-3 is an explicit reference/ownership measurement-series break. CMS-1 remains unchanged.

authority.statement: ESI-3 is the native deterministic source/symbol/static-reference inventory used by --inventory; it grants no MusicMutation, Writer, Repair, Selection or Release authority.

source_scope.inherit: ESI-2 source scope and symbol identity

reference_contract.lexical_only: Simple-name occurrences that are not syntactically plausible references remain diagnostic only and do not create ambiguity/reachability.
reference_contract.resolved: Calls, qualified paths, imports and function-value bindings are resolved only with deterministic evidence.
reference_contract.include_owner: Static include!("relative.rs") fragments inherit all proven enclosing function owners; multiple inclusion owners remain explicit rather than first-wins.
reference_contract.macro_owner: macro_rules! body references inherit proven invocation-function owners; unbound macro bodies do not invent reachability.
reference_contract.self_method: self.method() may resolve only to the unique same-impl method; other dot-member calls remain ambiguous without receiver proof.
reference_contract.value_binding: Function values/callbacks, including qualified function values, propagate reachability.
reference_contract.ambiguous: Unresolved plausible reference sites remain explicit and block removal proof.

fingerprints.signature_shape: signature fingerprint with function-name placeholder for duplicate/replacement evidence

comparability.rule: ESI-3 reference/reachability counts are not directly comparable to ESI-2; source symbol identity remains stable where path+qualified_symbol are unchanged.
